name: 最低料金と最高料金の入力欄
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0076 最低料金と最高料金の入力欄. Input1 ORIGINAL controls two price inputs, labels above and widely separated left/right alignment. Input2 native mock supplies Japanese labels and example yen values; values are static examples, not currency conversion.
On purewhite#FFFFFF, two white outlined rounded pill-shaped price inputs aligned at same baseline and height. Above first: "最低料金"; above second: "最高料金", both Meiryo REGULAR40012/16-equivalent muted#6E6E6E tracking0. In first field exact "￥2,000"; second exact "￥25,000", Meiryo REGULAR40014/24-equivalent dark#1D1D1D tracking0, clear yen symbol and commas. Center each value in its field. Both fields identical width/height and source rounded outline weight; preserve compact label-to-field gap and generous gap between columns. No bold or semibold anywhere.
Neutral resting inputs: white fill, fine neutral border, no green emphasis, gradient, shadow or selected/focused/invalid state. No histogram, slider, title, buttons, icons, connector dash, extra amounts, phone or surrounding modal. Small white outside margins, frontal crisp wide component raster. Editing/validation and price filtering behavior unverified.
reviewNotes: Two neutral minimum/maximum pill inputs, Japanese labels and authored yen examples2000/25000 readable, Regular type, equal field dimensions/baseline and white surface. No false focus/selection. Agent-reviewed raster candidate only; exact font identity, editable numeric validation/filter behavior and owner approval unverified.
